name: axon-lsp
description: LSP and Syntax Highlighting for the Axon programming language

axonLsp.externalPaths.description: Additional source directories outside the current workspace, including Haxall installations or source checkouts. Scanned recursively up to 4 directory levels for .trio, .axon, .fan, .xeto, and .xetolib archives. Earlier paths take precedence when functions have the same name.

axonLsp.indexAllWorkspaceFolders.description: Index every folder in a multi-root VS Code workspace as local Axon sources. Disabled by default because large workspaces may increase startup time and memory usage.

axonLsp.mode.description: Choose whether bundled function metadata prefers legacy defs, newer specs, or decides automatically based on future workspace support.

axonLsp.ignoreBundledXetoCache.description: Ignore bundled Xeto function and nominal type metadata in all lookup modes. Workspace sources, configured external paths, and .xetolib archives remain available, along with the legacy defs cache and intrinsic primitive checks. Changes take effect without restarting the language server.

axonLsp.warnMissingArguments.description: Show diagnostics when a function call omits required arguments.

scripts.build:all: npm run compile && npm run build:server
scripts.package: npm run build:all && vsce package -o build
